name: Zannytecture
what_they_do: Lagos-based upcycling and sustainable design studio (Zannytecture Recycling Company Limited, founded 2021 by Zainab Kadiri-Lawal) crafting furniture, decor, and tote bags from discarded tyres, glass/PET bottles, and sachet waste, plus running waste-to-wealth workshops (500+ people trained).
recent_activity: 2026-11-10: Won NGN 1M (~$742) non-dilutive growth award in the NiYA x Cascador Founders Programme (https://www.startuplist.africa/funding/zannytecture-grant-1m-ngn-87be0fd); 2026-10-21: Announced NiYA x Cascador shortlist out of 19,000+ applicants on @zannytecture Instagram (https://instagram.com/p/DewX-pDDbCx); 2026-11-19: Founder Kadiri-Lawal Zainab Abike shared YabaTech graduation milestone collab post on @zannytecture (https://instagram.com/p/Df6avffkYAi)
investors: Cascador / Nigerian Youth Academy (NiYA) / Federal Ministry of Youth Development
marketing_titles_found: NONE (zannytecture.com names only Founder Zainab Kadiri-Lawal; no public team directory or marketing/growth/content titles)
hiring_marketing_role: NO (no careers or open roles page on zannytecture.com)
unique_offer: Lagos sustainable furniture and decor brand transforming tyres, glass bottles, and sachet waste into handcrafted pieces alongside paid workshops.
pitch_hook: Zannytecture sells handcrafted upcycled furniture online and won NiYA-Cascador backing on 2026-11-10, yet its @zannytecture Instagram has irregular 18-day median post gaps (up to 81 days between posts), its e-commerce site lacks a blog, and it has no dedicated marketing lead.
